# Avogadro — llms.txt

Avogadro is a standalone Minecraft 1.7.10 (Forge) library mod with no required
dependencies. It renders spinning 3D ball-and-stick molecules in item tooltips,
in a NEI "Molecules" recipe category, and in WAILA/HWYLA and The One Probe
overlays when those mods are installed. Any modpack can add molecules for any
item or fluid without writing code, and other mods can register them through the
Java API.

## Where molecule files live

One source only: the client config directory.

`config/avogadro/molecules/<name>.json` -> molecule id `avogadro:<name>`

There are no datapacks, resource packs or server sync on 1.7.10. The directory
is created when missing and any missing bundled defaults are written on startup;
existing files are never overwritten. Bundled defaults include `c60`,
`diamond`, `graphene`, `graphite` and `nanotube_10_10` alongside the small
molecules. Files are read once at startup; restart the game after editing.

Invalid files are skipped silently.

## File format

One JSON object per file. All fields optional except the geometry source.

```json
{
  "smiles": "CC(=O)C",
  "formula": "C3H6O",
  "items": ["mymod:acetone_bucket", "mymod:acetone_bottle"],
  "item_tags": ["ketoneAcetone"],
  "fluids": ["acetone"],
  "match_containers": true,
  "copy": "avogadro:acetone"
}
```

Field reference:

- `smiles`: structure from a SMILES string. Supported: organic subset
  B C N O P S F I, two-letter elements Si Cl Br Na Mg Al K Ca Fe Cu Zn
  and the rest of the element table, aromatic b c n o p s, bracket atoms
  for anything else such as [U] or [nH], bond symbols - = # : / and
  backslash, branches ( ), ring closures 0-9 and %nn, and . for
  disconnected fragments. Chiral @ markers and reaction > arrows are
  ignored. Implicit hydrogens are filled from valence and a force-directed
  layout is applied. Examples: "O" water, "C" methane, "CC" ethane, "C=C"
  ethene, "C#C" acetylene, "O=C=O" carbon dioxide, "N" ammonia, "O=S=O"
  sulfur dioxide, "c1ccccc1" benzene, "CC(=O)C" acetone, "CCO" ethanol,
  "[Na]" sodium, "[C]" carbon, "O[Ca]O" slaked lime.
- `atoms`: explicit geometry, alternative to `smiles`. If both are present,
  `atoms` wins. Array of `{"e": "O", "x": 0, "y": 0, "z": 0}` where `e` is an
  element symbol and x/y/z are floats in bond-length units.
- `bonds`: explicit bonds for `atoms` geometry. Each entry is
  `[from, to]` or `[from, to, type]` with 0-based atom indices. Type is
  "SINGLE" (default), "DOUBLE", "TRIPLE", "QUADRUPLE", or 1/2/3/4, or one of
  -=#. Omit `bonds` to auto-bond atoms closer than 1.3x their summed radii.
- `fullerene`: buckminsterfullerene. `60` or `{"carbons": 60}`. Only C60 is
  currently generated. The hydrogen-free C60 formula is computed automatically.
- `nanotube`: finite single-walled carbon nanotube, for example
  `{"n": 10, "m": 10, "cells": 3}`. `n`/`m` are the chiral indices and
  `cells` is the number of translational unit cells along the axis. The
  circumference is seamless; the tube ends are open and not capped.
- `crystal`: finite crystal cluster. For example
  `{"lattice": "diamond", "element": "C", "cells": 2}`. Supported lattices:
  `diamond`, `graphite` (use `layers` for the layer count), `graphene` (a
  single graphite layer), `simple` / `simple_cubic`, `bcc`, `fcc`, and
  `rock_salt` / `nacl` (use `"elements": ["Na", "Cl"]`). `cells` is the number
  of conventional unit cells per axis. Atoms are bonded to nearest neighbours
  only.
- Geometry source precedence: `copy` > `atoms` > `smiles` > `fullerene` >
  `nanotube` > `crystal`. Use only one unless you intentionally want the
  higher-priority source to win.
- Structures are capped at 2048 atoms to keep the tooltip renderer usable.
  A larger generator request is skipped as invalid.
- `formula`: display string shown in the tooltip and in NEI. Omit to
  auto-compute Hill order (C, then H, then alphabetical) with Unicode
  subscripts, e.g. H2O renders as H + subscript 2 + O.
- `items`: item registry names that show this molecule, e.g.
  "minecraft:water_bucket" or "mymod:acetone_bottle".
- `item_tags`: ore dictionary names, e.g. "ingotCopper". A leading `#` is
  accepted and stripped. 1.7.10 has no item tags, so ore dictionary entries
  are the equivalent.
- `fluids`: 1.7.10 fluid names, e.g. "water", "flowing_water" or
  "mymod.fluidname". Names may carry a `modid:` prefix; only the part after
  the colon is compared.
- `materials`: accepted for parity with the newer versions but ignored;
  GregTech 5 Unofficial has no equivalent material registry here.
- `match_containers`: default true. When true, any item holding a bound fluid
  (buckets, cells, tanks) also shows the molecule. Set false so the molecule
  only matches the fluid itself.
- `copy`: reuse another molecule's geometry, e.g. `"copy": "avogadro:water"`.
  Own `formula` overrides the copied one; own target lists are unioned with
  the copied ones. Useful in config to bind new items to an existing shape
  without copying coordinates.

## Resolution order for a hovered item

1. Direct item registry name match in `items`.
2. Ore dictionary match in `item_tags`.
3. Fluid inside the item (bucket/cell contents) matched against `fluids`,
   when that molecule has `match_containers: true`.
4. Fallback: a molecule whose path equals the item path
   (item `mymod:acetone` matches molecule `anything:acetone`).
   Explicit bindings always beat the fallback.

Fluid hovers start at the fluid step.

## Java API

Mods can register definitions from code with
`com.trifectumsoftware.avogadro.api.AvogadroAPI`. API definitions are merged
with the config files and win when the ids collide; they also survive a config
reload. Register from the client proxy on 1.7.10 because the registry is
client-side.

```java
MoleculeDef acetone = AvogadroAPI.builder("mymod:acetone")
    .smiles("CC(=O)C")
    .item("mymod:acetone_bottle")
    .fluid("acetone")
    .register();
```

`MoleculeBuilder` supports `smiles`, `fullerene`, `nanotube`, `crystal`,
`structure`, `formula`, `copy`, `item`, `items`, `itemTag`, `itemTags`,
`fluid`, `fluids`, `fluidTag`, `fluidTags`, `material`, `materials`,
`matchContainers`, `build`, and `register`.
`AvogadroAPI` exposes `register`, `unregister`, `get`, `molecules`, `forItem`,
and `forFluid`. A `MoleculeDef` can also be constructed directly with
`MoleculeStructure` and passed to `register`.

## WAILA, HWYLA, The One Probe

WAILA and HWYLA receive the formula and a spinning model through their tooltip
renderer API. The provider is registered through WAILA's IMC hook, so it is only
loaded when WAILA is installed. The One Probe and The One Smeagle are supported
through a reflection bridge that registers a provider and a custom element; the
bridge is dormant on 1.7.10 because TOP does not publish a 1.7.10 build.

HEI (Had Enough Items) is the 1.12.2 JEI fork and cannot be loaded on 1.7.10.
The NEI category is the 1.7.10 recipe-viewer integration; a future 1.12.2 build
can consume the same `AvogadroAPI.molecules()` data from a JEI/HEI plugin.

## Geometry cache

Spheres, cubes, and bond cylinders are generated once per molecule and cached
as a precomputed triangle/colour list. Rendering only applies the placement and
spin transform, so no trigonometry or lighting math runs per frame. Large
structures automatically use a lower sphere/cylinder tessellation so nanotubes
and crystal clusters stay affordable. The cache is warmed during client
post-init for the configured atom style (`cubicAtoms`) and falls back to lazy
building if a molecule is registered later.

## Config (config/avogadro.cfg)

- `enableTooltips`: show molecules in tooltips. Default true.
- `tooltipSize`: molecule box in pixels, 16-128. Default 64.
- `spinSeconds`: seconds per full rotation, 0.5-60. Default 6.0.
- `neiCategory`: register the NEI Molecules category. Default true.
- `wailaCompat`: show molecules in the WAILA/HWYLA block overlay. Default true.
- `wailaSize`: molecule model size in the WAILA/HWYLA overlay, 16-64. Default 32.
- `cubicAtoms`: render atoms as cubes and bonds as square sticks instead of
  spheres and tubes. Default false.

## NEI notes

- Tooltips render the same molecule model as the modern versions: the formula
  line is added through `ItemTooltipEvent` and the model is drawn inside the
  vanilla tooltip box by a mixin on `GuiScreen.drawHoveringText`.
- The Molecules category lists every configured molecule with its formula,
  its id and a single slot that cycles through every bound item. Press U on a
  bound item to find it.
- Category contents are read at NEI startup, so restart after editing config
  molecule files.

## Minimal examples

C60 buckminsterfullerene (60 atoms, 90 bonds) and a (10,0) zigzag nanotube:

```json
{
  "fullerene": 60
}
```

```json
{
  "nanotube": {
    "n": 10,
    "m": 0,
    "cells": 4
  }
}
```

Diamond lattice for the diamond item, and a two-layer graphite cluster:

```json
{
  "crystal": {
    "lattice": "diamond",
    "element": "C",
    "cells": 2
  },
  "formula": "C",
  "items": ["minecraft:diamond", "minecraft:diamond_block"]
}
```

```json
{
  "crystal": {
    "lattice": "graphite",
    "element": "C",
    "cells": 3,
    "layers": 2
  },
  "formula": "C"
}
```

A single graphene sheet (the same generator with one layer):

```json
{
  "crystal": {
    "lattice": "graphene",
    "element": "C",
    "cells": 4
  },
  "formula": "C"
}
```

Rock salt (NaCl):

```json
{
  "crystal": {
    "lattice": "rock_salt",
    "elements": ["Na", "Cl"],
    "cells": 2
  },
  "formula": "NaCl"
}
```

Bind an existing shape to your items (config/avogadro/molecules/acetone.json):

```json
{
  "copy": "avogadro:benzene",
  "formula": "C3H6O",
  "items": ["mymod:acetone_bottle"],
  "fluids": ["acetone"]
}
```

Hand-placed water molecule (equivalent to `"smiles": "O"`):

```json
{
  "formula": "H2O",
  "atoms": [
    {"e": "O", "x": 0, "y": 0, "z": 0},
    {"e": "H", "x": -0.593, "y": 0.459, "z": 0},
    {"e": "H", "x": 0.593, "y": 0.459, "z": 0}
  ],
  "items": ["mymod:water_bottle"],
  "fluids": ["water"]
}
```

Sulfuric acid with explicit double bonds:

```json
{
  "smiles": "OS(=O)(=O)O",
  "items": ["mymod:acid_bottle"]
}
```
